title: Xiaomi: New CPU matches Apple cores single threaded, much faster multithreaded
summary: Xiaomi has developed a new custom CPU that achieves Apple-level single-threaded performance while significantly outperforming it in multi-threaded workloads, representing a major advancement in mobile semiconductor design.
problem_solved: Reduces the performance gap between non-Apple Android chips and Apple's A-series/M-series processors in both single and multi-threaded scenarios.
why_valuable: Demonstrates China's growing semiconductor capabilities and could disrupt the premium mobile chip market currently dominated by Apple and Qualcomm.
